# Jimenez Guerrero Tire Shop

> New & used tires, flat repair based in Austin, Texas. New and used tires, flat patches, mounting and balancing at the hand-painted shop on Monsanto Dr. Customers keep saying the same thing: in and out in about 10 minutes.

## Services
- Flat tire repair: Picked up a nail? Pull in and we patch it fast. Reviewers call it a NASCAR pitstop.
- Used tires: Good used tires with plenty of tread left, matched to the tires already on your car.
- New tires: New tires for cars, trucks and SUVs, including all-terrain and mud tires for lifted rigs. Free balancing when you get four.
- Computer balance & rotation: Tires mounted, wheels computer-balanced and tires rotated, so the ride stays smooth on the highway.
- Wheels & tire packages: Fresh wheels and tires together, from chrome on a classic Chevy to black wheels on a Tacoma.
- No credit needed: Need tires but short on cash right now? Ask about financing with no credit needed.

## About
Jimenez Guerrero Tire Shop sits on Monsanto Dr at Montopolis in Southeast Austin. You can't miss it: blue hand-painted letters over a big red TIRE SHOP sign, a yellow banner that says it all in English and Spanish, and tire stacks out front. It's a family-owned, no-frills shop. Pull in with a flat and they come right out to your car and get to work, whether you drive a daily commuter, a work truck, a lifted Tacoma or a GT-R. Customers say it best: not pushy, no upselling, just letting you know what your tires need. We keep good used tires and new tires on hand, mount, computer-balance and rotate on site, and offer financing with no credit needed. Open seven days a week.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Most customers just pull in. If you want to make sure we have your size first, call (512) 653-9253.
- Q: How long does a flat repair take?
  A: Customers regularly tell us they were in and out in 10 to 15 minutes. Busy times can take a little longer.
- Q: Do you sell used tires?
  A: Yes. We carry used tires with good tread left and can match them to the tires already on your car.
- Q: Do you balance and rotate tires?
  A: Yes. We do computer wheel balancing and tire rotation, and balancing is free when you buy four new tires.
- Q: Do you offer financing?
  A: Yes, we offer financing with no credit needed. Ask at the shop for details.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 6301 Monsanto Dr at Montopolis. Mon to Fri 7:30 AM to 7 PM, Sat 7:30 to 5, Sun 8 to 3. Call (512) 653-9253 or (512) 653-9251.
